title: Near-Gaussian counterexamples to the Ball-Nayar-Tkocz entropy concavity conjecture
summary: The Ball-Nayar-Tkocz conjecture asserts that, for independent real random variables $X,Y$ with a common log-concave density, the function $t\mapsto h(\sqrt tX+\sqrt{1-t}Y)$ is concave on $[0,1]$. Gaussian distributions have this property. We construct strongly log-concave counterexamples arbitrarily close to the Gaussian and study their persistence under Gaussian smoothing. Let $X$ have mean zero and variance one, let $G$ be an independent standard Gaussian, and let $q\in[0,1]$ denote the signal variance proportion in the smoothed variable $\sqrt qX+\sqrt{1-q}G$.
